reserveReview.rationale: The 2026-08-29 review retained a conservative Chilean-peso cash and liquid-instrument envelope. On 2026-10-02 the official attestation index was found to link a wCLP-specific certification headed 2026-06-30 and signed 2026-07-28. The liability procedure instead names 2026-03-31, and the reserve procedure and conclusion mix Chilean pesos with ARS and Argentine pesos. This proves publication of a token-specific report, not a reliable dated CLP balance or category split. The reserve envelope, its original review date and all unknown safeguards are retained pending issuer/accountant clarification; no current composition date or protective tier is inferred.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: Ripio wFIAT local-stablecoin disclosure for wCLP; linked June 2026 certification has unresolved liability-date and reserve-currency inconsistencies
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: The full 100% reserve envelope remains unclassified beyond Chilean-peso cash and local-currency liquid instruments. A wCLP-specific certification is published, but its internally inconsistent dates and currency do not establish reliable current category weights, named reserve institutions, or a matched CLP assets/liabilities denominator.
